intro: Sherman Oaks has the Valley's busiest stretch of Ventura Boulevard, lined with restaurants, coffee shops and bars from the 405 east toward Studio City, plus easy access to the Santa Monica Mountains to the south.

gm: Google Maps reviews (local favorites Nathaniel checked)

places.w: A bright specialty coffee bar with good pastries and a few patio tables.
places.o: A flat white or cortado with an almond croissant.

places.w: Ludo Lefebvre's French brasserie, at its best in the morning.
places.o: The breakfast sandwich, an omelet and croissants.

places.w: A tiny takeout window for flaky stuffed bourekas.
places.o: The cheese bourekas. Go early before they sell out.
The chicken shawarma wrap in thin, crisp pita.
Sumac fries, Moroccan chicken and a tahini shake.

places.w: A family-run Thai restaurant that ranks among the best in LA, with a big natural wine list.
places.o: Southern Thai fried chicken, or Thai taco night on Tuesdays.

places.w: A decades-old French bistro, recently reopened.
places.o: French onion soup and the garlic confit caesar.

places.w: A sushi bar with a serious wine program.
A classic steakhouse with ice-cold martinis.
A high-energy cantina known for inventive margaritas.
Three castle-themed mini golf courses plus batting cages and an arcade, open since 1974.
places.o: A round of mini golf at night.
